nodes.label: esp-webrtc-solution (vendored source)
nodes.rationale: codec_board is vendored from Espressif esp-webrtc-solution rather than pulled from the registry, allowing a custom board_cfg.txt entry for this board

nodes.label: Board config S3_ePaper_1_54 (ES8311, I2C 47/48, I2S pins, PA 46)
nodes.norm_label: board config s3_epaper_1_54 (es8311, i2c 47/48, i2s pins, pa 46)

nodes.label: Power policy (RTC alarm wake, deep sleep)
nodes.norm_label: power policy (rtc alarm wake, deep sleep)
nodes.rationale: Touch wake from deep sleep unverified (depends on FT6336 INT being RTC GPIO); fall back to PWR button

nodes.label: UI-service event queue (EVT_TOUCH, EVT_REC_START, EVT_REC_STOP, EVT_PLAY_DONE, EVT_SD_ERROR, EVT_MINUTE_TICK)
nodes.norm_label: ui-service event queue (evt_touch, evt_rec_start, evt_rec_stop, evt_play_done, evt_sd_error, evt_minute_tick)

nodes.label: Waveshare 11_FactoryProgram example
nodes.rationale: Starting point because it already initializes power rails, I2C, touch, RTC, SD, ADC, SHTC3, buttons and codec

nodes.label: App state machine IDLE/RECORDING/PLAYING/SLEEPING
nodes.rationale: One codec, so playback and recording are interlocked; isRecording derived from state, not a separate flag

nodes.label: Display refresh policy (partial, full every N)
nodes.norm_label: display refresh policy (partial, full every n)
nodes.rationale: Full refresh every N partial refreshes clears ghosting; limited e-paper write cycles keep refresh count modest; nothing updates every second

nodes.label: Memory budget (DIRAM/IRAM/PSRAM/flash)
nodes.rationale: IRAM 16KB window is 100% full so new IRAM_ATTR code lands in DIRAM; large buffers (LVGL frame ~80KB, audio ring ~64KB) go in PSRAM; build for 8MB flash to match FLASH_CAP

nodes.label: 4-page linear navigation with fixed 4-slot bottom bar
nodes.norm_label: 4-page linear navigation with fixed 4-slot bottom bar
nodes.rationale: Slots never move so touch muscle memory stays consistent; <- means previous page in linear order; -> on Settings wraps to Home; tap only, no swipes

nodes.label: 64KB PSRAM audio ring buffer
nodes.rationale: ~2 s buffering mitigates SD card latency spikes

nodes.label: WAV PCM16 mono 16kHz streaming recording
nodes.rationale: Streamed via PSRAM ring buffer, header patched and fsync every ~2 s so file survives power cut up to last sync

nodes.label: FreeRTOS task layout (audio_rec, sd_writer, audio_play, ui, input, sensor)
nodes.norm_label: freertos task layout (audio_rec, sd_writer, audio_play, ui, input, sensor)
nodes.rationale: Audio and SD tasks pinned to core 1 away from UI task because e-paper refresh blocks 0.3-2 s
